items.title: Honeywell Aerospace CEO says vertical integration remains part of supply-chain resilience strategy
items.category: 航空機エンジン・製造
items.excerpt: Reuters reports Honeywell Aerospace is reintegrating selected core technologies outsourced in 2010–2019 and may pursue additional vertical integration. CEO Jim Currier said supplier-support deployments helped lift output about 30% year over year over the prior 30–45 days, while roughly 70 suppliers still had quality or delivery issues.

items.title: How RTX is using AI and data to transform aircraft maintenance
items.excerpt: RTX describes AI-assisted borescope inspection at Pratt & Whitney and predictive analytics at Collins Aerospace. RTX reports more than 30% overall inspection-time savings for AI borescoping, about 90% predictive accuracy for selected cooling/ventilation units, and a roadmap toward a unified predictive MRO data backbone.

items.title: Hermeus to manufacture Pratt & Whitney's F100-PW-229 engine under new production licensing agreement
items.category: 航空機エンジン・製造
items.excerpt: Pratt & Whitney and Hermeus signed a production license authorizing Hermeus to manufacture F100-PW-229 engines. RTX says the agreement establishes a new qualified U.S. production source for the fighter-engine family while requiring Pratt & Whitney quality, safety and site-activation standards.

items.title: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and Preferred Networks form capital and business alliance for mission-critical AI
items.excerpt: MHI and Preferred Networks announced a capital and business alliance to accelerate joint development of AI for intelligent and autonomous machinery and systems in mission-critical domains including national security. MHI plans a ¥10 billion investment in PFN, extending their June 2026 technical collaboration.

items.title: EdgeCortix signs multi-year agreement with Kawasaki Heavy Industries for AI-enabled aerospace and defense systems
items.excerpt: EdgeCortix and Kawasaki announced a 2026–2028, multimillion-dollar program covering technology development, feasibility studies, system integration and prototype platforms for AI-enabled aerospace and defense systems. Discovery candidate: EdgeCortix merits continued watch for energy-efficient edge AI in aerospace mission systems.

items.title: IonQ demonstrates quantum-accelerated CAE workflow with Synopsys on jet-engine-scale models
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: IonQ and Synopsys report a hybrid quantum/classical CAE study with 5.9–14.6% total runtime reduction across large industrial models, including a jet-engine assembly with meshes up to 35 million points. Physical execution was validated on IonQ hardware, making this worth monitoring as an emerging CAE acceleration path.
items.query: site:ionq.com/news September 17 2026 computer aided engineering jet engine Synopsys quantum

items.title: Aequs plans Hosur expansion for aero-engine and landing-system components
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Aequs CEO Aravind Melligeri says the planned ₹1,900-crore Hosur facility will target high-value aero-engine and complex landing-system components, including Inconel-class superalloy work, with operations targeted for H2 FY2027–28. The planned capability makes Aequs a useful aerospace-manufacturing watch candidate.

items.title: Aerospace suppliers test rare-earth-free turbine coating alternatives
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Reuters reports Oerlikon Metco is developing rare-earth-free turbine-coating formulations, including zirconia-based coatings using magnesium and calcium oxides, as aerospace suppliers seek alternatives to yttrium-dependent materials. The work is directly relevant to turbine materials and supply-chain resilience.
